title: macOS Enrollment, SSO & FileVault Troubleshooting & Diagnostics Toolkit
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (macOS + Microsoft Intune/Entra; configuration/identity/security work, live-fleet care).
White-label; Apple/Microsoft console internals authored click-by-click from public docs; anything uncertain flagged, not invented.
hook: Fix the Mac enrollment, SSO and FileVault failures — fast
problem: When a Mac won't enroll, Platform/Extensible SSO won't sign in, or FileVault/SecureToken blocks a user, the cause hides across the Apple profile, the Intune policy, and the Entra identity. This toolkit gives you a structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for the macOS + Intune stack — ADE/enrollment, SSO login, SecureToken/FileVault, compliance/CA, and post-enrollment lock-outs — so you isolate the failing layer in minutes.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the macOS-Intune signal path (ADE/enrollment → profiles → SSO → SecureToken/FileVault → compliance/CA) and the layered model behind the root-cause tree.
Requirements Guide — what you need to diagnose (Intune + Graph read access, device logs, the Apple/SSO vantage points) with how to verify each.

Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (ADE not assigned / enrollment stuck, SSO won't sign in, SecureToken/FileVault error, compliant-but-denied, user locked after enrollment) with exact checks per branch.

5 PowerShell scripts — enrollment/profile discovery, per-device SSO + SecureToken/FileVault validation, a consolidated diagnostics report, safe re-sync/remediation, and a target-group builder (read-only where it matters).
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides mapping each gate to the fix, plus Best Practices for evidence-based escalation.
short: A structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for macOS + Intune failures — ADE/enrollment, SSO login, SecureToken/FileVault, compliance/CA, post-enrollment lock-outs — isolate the failing layer fast. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
